source: https://imuga.immigration.gov.mv/traveller (public first step of the Traveller Declaration), https://www.immigration.gov.mv/traveller-declaration, https://www.immigration.gov.mv/visa/tourist-visa and the 13 August 2024 announcement listed at https://www.immigration.gov.mv/news, all read 2026-08-30. The public first step shows a passport data-page scan or upload, purpose of visit, and a conditional permit number and expiry. The tourist visa page names personal details, travel information and accommodation details. Beyond that, the live form publishes no readable HTML validation attributes, so no pattern, character limit or error message is claimed below.

passport_page.label: Passport data page
passport_page.placeholder: Scan or upload the data page
passport_page.help: The first public step of the declaration reads the passport data page by scan or upload. Have the physical passport, or a clear image of the data page, ready before starting.

errors.required: The passport data page is required

personal_details.label: Personal details
personal_details.help: Personal details are named on the official tourist entry page. Take every value from the passport data page rather than from a booking confirmation.

purpose.label: Purpose of visit
purpose.placeholder: The real reason for this trip
purpose.help: Purpose of visit appears on the public first step. Answer it as it is, because the tourist visa issued on arrival is tied to a short visit rather than to work or study.

permit_number.label: Permit number (conditional)
permit_number.help: The first step asks for a permit number only when one applies to the traveller. Leave it alone if the portal does not ask you for it.

permit_expiry.label: Permit expiry (conditional)
permit_expiry.help: The expiry date is asked alongside the conditional permit number. It applies to the same travellers and to nobody else.

travel_details.label: Travel information
travel_details.placeholder: Flight and trip details for this arrival
travel_details.help: Travel information is named on the official tourist entry page. Use the itinerary for the arrival covered by this declaration, submitted within the 96 hours before arrival.

accommodation.label: Accommodation details
accommodation.placeholder: Where you are staying in the Maldives
accommodation.help: Accommodation details are named on the official tourist entry page. Resort, guesthouse or hotel details for the stay belong here.
